# comfyui-MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize-T8 v0.3.6

## 中文

- 修复短音频尾部覆盖率、零时长段、NaN/Inf 输入和串联校验旧诊断残留；token 上限与早停风险现在会触发质量重试。
- 质量门新增“不可用时终止工作流”，长音频诊断示例默认开启，避免异常结果继续写盘。
- 修复重试进度倒退、加载中模型无法释放、损坏/非连续检查点阻断续跑，以及 Torchaudio 异常时缺少 SoXR 回退。
- 模型身份改用全文件 SHA-256；加载器显示请求精度到实际 dtype 的回退，直接模型目录显示真实名称。
- 修复 ASS 回车注入和短字幕切分扩张时间轴；切分结果保持在原始时间范围内。
- 发布包只收录 Git 跟踪文件，拒绝脏标签和符号链接，并统一换行以实现 Windows/Linux 字节一致构建。
- 手工 Registry 重发严格绑定已公开 tag；Release 权限拆分为只读构建与最小写权限发布，所有 checkout 禁止持久化凭据。
- Transformers 安全下限提升至 5.5.0，第三方声明与 Apache-2.0 修改标记按实际节点包修正。
- 自动化覆盖扩展至 91 个测试用例；模型权重和固定 OpenMOSS 审计 revision 保持不变。

## English

- Fixed short-audio end coverage, zero-duration segments, NaN/Inf inputs, and stale diagnostics after chained validation. Token-limit and early-stop risks now trigger quality retries.
- Added a fail-on-unusable quality-gate option and enabled it in the long-audio diagnostic example so rejected output cannot continue to file writing.
- Fixed retry progress regression, release requests during model loading, corrupt or non-contiguous checkpoints, and the missing SoXR fallback for a broken Torchaudio runtime.
- Model identity now uses full-file SHA-256. The loader reports requested precision versus effective dtype, and direct model roots use their real directory names.
- Fixed ASS carriage-return injection and subtitle splitting that expanded very short source segments beyond their original timeline.
- Release packages now contain tracked files only, reject dirty tags and symlinks, and normalize text bytes for identical Windows/Linux builds.
- Manual Registry republishing is bound to an existing published tag. Release permissions are split between read-only builds and minimally privileged publishing, with persisted checkout credentials disabled.
- Raised the Transformers security minimum to 5.5.0 and corrected third-party notices and Apache-2.0 modification markers to match the actual node package.
- Expanded automated coverage to 91 test cases. Model weights and the pinned OpenMOSS audit revision are unchanged.
